people.name: Lebanon
people.line: A mountainous region known for its cedar trees

translations.web: His legs are like pillars of marble set on sockets of fine gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.
translations.bsb: His legs are pillars of marble set on bases of pure gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, as majestic as the cedars.
translations.kjv: His legs are as pillars of marble, set upon sockets of fine gold: his countenance is as Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.
translations.asv: His legs are as pillars of marble, set upon sockets of fine gold: His aspect is like Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.
